notes.content: The heading introduces ramification data on a scheme. The first paragraph defines the datum via a category fibred over the étale site and a cartesian functor to relative schemes; it explicitly does not require a stack or a faithful functor. The second paragraph names the geometric-realization functor. The third describes the inverse-image category of finite étale covers and starts a new definition at the cut-off right edge. Source anchors: upper paragraph y331–1372; composite and display y1380–1591; final paragraph y1607–2078.
